verdict.rationale: Replit's first-party docs say publishing creates a production deployment that runs at its own shareable URL, through a 'simplified process'. The template flow ends with 'publish a live URL', and Public access makes the app reachable by anyone with the link. missing for 10: explicit documentation that publishing is literally a single step (the docs also describe choosing release settings and verifying), independent or hands-on corroboration of the publish flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Publishing creates a **production deployment**: a stable, shareable version of your app that runs at its own URL.
Publishing lets you share your Replit App with the world using a simplified process.
test it in Preview, and publish a live URL.
**Public** makes the app available to anyone with the link.
